text:
maria.chen: Hey team — quick sync: I put together a lightweight intake heatmap for the new model candidates. Need prioritization for next sprint (canary + quant experiments).

ashwin.kumar: Sharing the heatmap looks great. can we include rough latency delta on A100 and 3090 for each? that changes batching decisions. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria.chen: yep added a latency column. short summary: zephyr-v2 has best quality, but ~2.4x token latency vs baseline on A100; atlas-lite-8bit is close on MMLU but cheap and fast. ember-small-quant shows odd regressions on commonsense tests.

sasha: can you paste the scoring matrix here? quick numbers ok.

maria.chen: sure — here's the quick scoring I used (0-5 each):
```
Candidate           quality  latency  cost  infra-risk  privacy  total
zephyr-v2           5        2        2     3           4        16
atlas-lite-8bit     3        5        5     2           3        18
ember-small-quant   2        4        4     4           5        19
halcyon-30b-8k      4        3        3     2           4        16
```
(emboldened metrics are quality and latency; totals are for prioritization buckets)

kevin.p: wait ember has higher total because of infra-risk+privacy? that feels wrong to prioritize. maybe weight quality higher for onboarding?

maria.chen: agreed — these were raw sums. propose weights: quality*2, latency*1, cost*0.8, infra-risk*0.5, privacy*1.2. I can recalc and bucket into Must, High, Low.

olivia: PM note — roadmap alignment: we promised a low-cost embedding option for Q2 customers. atlas-lite-8bit being cheap + decent embed perf makes it High priority for commercial lane.

ashwin.kumar: engineering note — atlas-lite-8bit quant path is straightforward (we have conversion scripts), can do basic 8-bit run and perf check in 3 days. zephyr-v2 needs kernel tuning for large context, ~2 weeks on infra side.

maria.chen: proposed plan:
- This week: run weighted scoring and post final buckets.
- Next week: atlas-lite-8bit quant + embed eval (canary on dedicated small pool).
- Parallel: start perf profiling for zephyr-v2 (latency hotspots).
- Ember-small-quant: triage regression test set, rollback quant recipe if regressions persist.

sasha: sounds good. add a short eval checklist for ember regressions so we can decide rollback vs fix: failing tests, sample prompts, delta thresholds.

maria.chen: added checklist to the doc and linked in #docs (see: https://redwood.internal/rs/onboard-heatmap). cc @kevin.p for rollout policy.

kevin.p: for canary I want: 1) token cap per session, 2) fallback to baseline model on timeout, 3) metric alert (latency P95 > SLA) — will add to canary config.

ci-bot: Pipeline started for atlas-lite-8bit quant run (job id: 4821). Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821

maria.chen: perfect. i'll post the weighted scores and final buckets by EOD PST. thanks all! :raised_hands:
